name: rename-api
title: Rename an API with a deprecated alias
prompt:
In the `school` package, rename `get_user` to `fetch_user` everywhere in the package code.
- `fetch_user` must be importable from the package root (`from school import fetch_user`).
- Keep `get_user` working as a deprecated alias: it returns the same result and emits a
  `DeprecationWarning`. It must also stay importable from the package root.
- Internal code (e.g. `school/service.py`) must call `fetch_user`, not the alias.
